entry.title: The Accessibility Problem With Authentication Methods Like CAPTCHA
entry.summary: CAPTCHAs were meant to keep bots out, but too often, they lock people with disabilities out, too. From image classification to click-based tests, many “human checks” are anything but inclusive. There’s no universal solution, but understanding real user needs is where accessibility truly starts.
